app.name: AI Ticket Monitoring
app.short_description: Review AI ticket satisfaction and session details.
app.long_description: A read-only dashboard for completed AI support monitoring sessions. It shows ticket-level satisfaction, session-level score breakdowns, searchable records, and monitoring details saved by the support platform in SQL Server. Estimated satisfaction is not Zendesk's official CSAT.
app.installation_instructions: Enter the HTTPS monitoring backend hostname and its report API key. The key is stored securely by Zendesk and added to requests outside the browser.

monitoring_api_hostname.label: Monitoring API hostname
monitoring_api_hostname.helpText: Backend hostname only, for example your-app.azurewebsites.net. Do not include https://, a port, or a path.

monitoring_api_key.label: Monitoring report API key
monitoring_api_key.helpText: Enter the backend REPORT_API_KEY. Zendesk stores this value securely; do not add it to app source files.
